landing.title:
Honest guest feedback,
with one QR code
landing.lead: Anonymous, so guests tell you what they never say out loud. Fix it and grow.
landing.faq2q: Can I see who wrote a question?
landing.faq2a: No. No name, contact or IP is kept.
landing.faq3a: Slurs are blocked, and you can hide, delete or block.
landing.faq4q: If I rename my shop, do I need a new QR?
landing.faq4a: No. Your link and QR never change.
landing.closing: Put it up today, hear them tomorrow
landing.ex1Q: Do you sell the decaf beans too?
landing.ex1A: Yes, in 200g bags. Just ask at the counter.
landing.ex2Q: Chargers at every seat would be great
landing.ex2A: From next week every seat will have a USB-C charger.
landing.how1: Ready the moment you sign up
landing.how2Sample: The latte was a bit weak today
landing.how3Sample: Thanks for telling us. We adjusted the dose.
